name: What types of finishes are used for log home refinishing?
description: Common finishes include oil-based and water-based stains and sealants, each with different properties and benefits.

mainEntity.name: What types of finishes are used for log home refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of finishes used for log home refinishing, primarily oil-based and water-based stains and sealants. Oil-based finishes penetrate the wood deeply, offering excellent protection and a natural look. Water-based finishes are often more environmentally friendly, dry faster, and offer good UV protection. The best choice depends on factors like climate, desired appearance, and maintenance preferences.
